description: Adversarial offer-letter extraction fixtures for the verification layer. Every case carries the same canonical source letter (with synonym language: the source says 'Annual Target Compensation', never 'Base Salary'), and a full OfferLetterExtraction object. Cases cover the four failure families a real model produces: salary ranges, OCR-style messy whitespace, missing fields, and synonym ambiguity.
canonicalSource:
AEGIS ROBOTICS
Offer of Employment

Dear Morgan Alvarez,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Senior Software Engineer at AEGIS Robotics.

Annual Target Compensation: $185,000 - $195,000 (DOE)
Signing Bonus: $25,000
Equity: 4,000 RSUs vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff
Performance Bonus: up to 15% of Annual Target Compensation
Paid Time Off: 25 days
Remote Policy: fully remote
Notice Period: 30 days
This offer expires 2026-08-15.

cases.description: Value is the top of the quoted range and the rawQuote is the full verbatim range string. Should pass: the quote exists in the source, the value is honest.

cases.description: A quote spanning a line break inside a name ('Morgan\n  Alvarez') is NOT collapsed: the OCR tolerance in the verifier only fixes whitespace inside number tokens, never general whitespace. This deliberately fails QUOTE_NOT_FOUND — it documents the tightened policy, not a regression.
